title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Funding Uncertain
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau led a LIV Golf players-only meeting at Trump Bedminster amid unclear league survival without new funding after 2026.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler's Strange Season
items.text: Golf analyst Brandel Chamblee highlighted Scottie Scheffler's unusual 2026 PGA Tour season, suggesting he merits PGA Tour Player of the Year consideration.

items.headline: Nelly Korda Best in Majors
items.text: Nelly Korda leads the first two majors and received the LPGA award for the best performance in the majors this season.
